The Quiet Craft of Reading in Two Languages

A translated page should feel like a proofread manuscript: the editor's notes sit beside the original, never on top of it.

Why paragraph-level translation works

Language models lose context when they translate sentence by sentence. Grouping a whole paragraph keeps pronouns, tense and tone aligned.

  • Blocks become readable units instead of fragments.
  • Lists and headings keep their rhythm.
  • Code and editable fields stay untouched.
Translation is not a replacement for the original. It is a second reading.

What this fixture proves

Surface What we check
Bilingual mode Original and translation sit side by side.
